envelope.description: Store the BUILD and TESTS rounds through the service

body.title: Store the BUILD and TESTS rounds through the service
body.summary: Make persistBuildRecord, persistStandaloneBuildRecord and persistTestRecordTask async with an optional RoundWriter that stores the content through updateContent before the raw writers refresh meta and markdown; await them in the validate and implement phases and in ensureBuildRecordOnCompletion with the registry's RoundWriter; a TESTS markdown failure after the content was stored is not rolled back; a failed store fails the persist; migrate the tests of these writers and their callers with them.
acceptanceChecks: a BUILD and a TESTS round are logged with their outcome by the staged write that replaces the record, and the earlier round stays readable in the log
a TESTS persist whose markdown fails after the content was stored keeps the committed content and entry, and the next persist renders the markdown
a failed round log fails the persist, leaves the staged write in the journal, and the next update finishes it so approval is not refused
without a RoundWriter the writers behave as before, including the TESTS json-then-markdown rollback

tests.name: round-recording.test.ts: persistBuildRecord and persistTestRecordTask with a RoundWriter store the content through the service and log the round, and the earlier round stays readable in the log
round-recording.test.ts: a TESTS persist whose markdown fails after the content was stored keeps the committed content and entry, and the next persist renders the markdown
round-recording.test.ts: a failed round log fails the persist, leaves the staged write in the journal, and the next update finishes it so the next approval is not refused
